7Bit review


General


Is 7Bit legit?


Yes. 7Bit has been paying players since 2014, which puts it at roughly 12 years old and among the true veterans of crypto gambling, and once Curaçao overhauled its licensing regime, it held a Curaçao Gaming Authority licence issued in August 2024.


The one recurring sore spot in its public record is players from blocked countries who manage to deposit, win, and then have the winnings voided at cashout. With the longest restricted list of any casino I cover, check your country before you fund, because 7Bit will hold you to the terms.


Is there a no deposit bonus code for 7Bit?


Yes, and it's ours. Sign up through BCK, enter code 75BIT, and 75 free spins land in your account before you've deposited anything.


Winnings carry 45x wagering, cashout is capped at $50, and you get 3 days to clear it. The spin count is generous, the 45x is heavy, and three days is a sprint, so treat it as a free look at the lobby rather than a bankroll builder.


Does 7Bit keep rewarding you after the welcome package?


Plenty, and this is where 7Bit genuinely shines. The VIP club is open to everyone from your first deposit: you collect comp points as you play, each new level pays a level-up bonus, your cashback wagering gets lighter as you climb, and from level 7 you get a personal host and tailored offers.


Deposit $50 or more and you also earn a spin on the Wheel of Fortune, which can pay up to 100 free spins or $35 in real money. Around that sits the free spins calendar I covered in my last 7Bit Review: Wednesday spins scaled to your deposit, a Monday reload, weekend spins, and weekly cashback that grows with your level.


Payments


How long do withdrawals take at 7Bit?


7Bit doesn't put a withdrawal timeframe in its terms, so there's no written figure you can hold them to. The brand's reputation is for quick crypto cashouts, and nothing in my last visit contradicted that.


The moment it matters is when a cashout gets pulled for a manual check. With nothing in writing, that wait has no floor, and I'd much rather see a number I can point at.


Are there any withdrawal restrictions I should know about?


Two. Every deposit must be wagered 3x before you can withdraw it, even if you never touch a bonus, and that climbs to 10x on table and live games; 1x is the norm, and [Cashy](placeholder) sticks to it if that rule bothers you.


Then there's KYC, which can be triggered at any point with no threshold and no published review time. If a document request lands mid-cashout, there's no clock on how long 7Bit takes to look at them.


What are the withdrawal limits?


No daily cap, but the terms now set $10,000 per week and $40,000 per month. That's half of the $20,000 and $80,000 I recorded a month ago, and neither figure is generous for a casino this established.


Anything you win above $40,000 gets paid in monthly instalments of up to $40,000. Progressive jackpots are the one exception, paid in full.


Do the bonus terms affect withdrawals?


All four bonuses do. Our exclusive 175% up to 1.5 BTC + 100 free spins (code 175BIT) carries 35x wagering on bonus and spins with a 3-day window, and a $100 max cashout that makes the 1.5 BTC headline close to meaningless; the $50 max bet is the one friendly term.


The standard 100% up to 6.4 mBTC + 100 free spins stretches to 14 days but applies 35x to the bonus, the deposit and the spins, with a $1 max bet and winnings capped at 1.3 mBTC. That's a lot of grinding at tiny stakes.


The 80 free spins for $5 (code SPIN80) and the 75 no deposit spins (75BIT) both carry 45x wagering and 3 days, with cashout capped at $100 and $50 respectively. Low risk in, low ceiling out.


Can I deposit different altcoins at 7Bit?


11 cryptocurrencies, covering the everyday names: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin and Tether are all in the cashier, and stablecoin deposits start from about $0.50. It's enough for most of you, and there's a buy-crypto option if your wallet's empty, though no swap feature, so whatever coin you deposit is the coin you play in.


Hold something more exotic, and [BitStarz](placeholder) takes more than 260 coins through its built-in exchange.


Games


How many games does 7Bit have?


Around 5,000 games, which is a decent library, though it's a smaller number than the 7,000-plus I counted a month ago, so either titles have been trimmed or the shelves were recounted. Either way it's sorted into clean collections like Megaways, Bonus Buy, Crash and Hold & Win, so finding your lane takes seconds.


If sheer volume is what you're after, [Oshi](placeholder) runs around 12,000 games.


Can I find games from the big studios at 7Bit?


89 providers is a lot, and nearly every major studio is here. Evolution and Pragmatic Play both anchor the live floor, which is the pairing I want to see for game shows and dealer tables.


The only gaps are Novomatic and QuickSpin. Neither is a dealbreaker on a roster this deep.


Does 7Bit have Originals or provably fair games?


Both. The 7Bit Exclusives are branded Originals built by partner studios, titles like 7Bit & Hot Fruits and Wolf of 7Bit Street, and the collection has grown since my earlier visits.


Provably fair games come from BGaming and Spribe, including Aviator and the Plinko and Mines builds in the Instant Wins tab.


Can I filter games by RTP or volatility at 7Bit?


Yes, and the filters actually work. Being able to sort by RTP and volatility means you can match a slot to your risk appetite instead of scrolling blind, and it's a small thing too many casinos still skip.


Responsible Gambling


Can I self-exclude at 7Bit?


Yes, and you switch it on yourself from the responsible gaming page, no support ticket needed. Just know it moved out of the profile area, so you'll need to go looking for it.


What other responsible gambling tools does 7Bit offer?


Deposit, wager, loss and time limits, plus a cooling-off option, all of them self-serve. That's five tools besides self-exclusion, which is more than most crypto casinos bother with, and the only thing missing is a reality-check reminder.


FAQ


Who owns 7Bit?


7Bit spent most of its life under Dama N.V., the Curaçao operator behind Katsubet and Mirax among others, and most sources still describe it as run by Dama N.V., a Curaçao-based operator behind many crypto-friendly brands. The picture has shifted this year, though: the most recent change moved the domain onto Scores55 Tech B.V.'s licence, first granted on 16 July 2024, and as of mid-2026 the register certificate for 7bitcasino.com names Scores55 as operator.


Either way it's a disclosed, long-running operation rather than an anonymous shell, and that's what I care about.


Can I use a VPN to play at 7Bit?


I wouldn't. 7Bit blocks 221 countries, the longest restricted list of any casino I cover, and it doesn't permit VPN use; the recurring complaint in its public record is exactly this, players from blocked countries depositing fine and then having winnings voided at cashout.


If you need somewhere that tolerates a VPN, [BC.Game](placeholder) restricts just 7 countries and its terms don't restrict VPN use.


Can I stay anonymous at 7Bit?


Signup is email-only, so you can register, deposit and play without handing over a name or address. Withdrawal is where it can change: the terms set no KYC threshold, which means a document request can land on any cashout, big or small, with no published time for the review.


In practice anonymity holds right up to the point 7Bit asks, and it can ask whenever it likes. Start with a modest first withdrawal and see how it goes.


Is 7Bit's support any good?


Yes. Live chat runs 24/7, with email at support@7bitcasino.com and a searchable FAQ behind it, and when I tested it the agent understood the problem from my first message and fixed it without a single follow-up question.


The one wrinkle is the chatbot screen: last time it tried to fob me off with an email address instead of connecting a human, so ask twice if you need a live agent. The site runs in 4 languages, which is thin if English isn't your first.


Is 7Bit easy to find your way around?


Very. Bonuses, wallet, transaction history and the game collections all sit exactly where you'd expect them, and I got from login to the right slot in a few clicks every time.


That kind of tidy structure tells me a casino takes its own business seriously. The responsible gaming page is the one thing you'll have to hunt for.


Is 7Bit good for highrollers?


No. The $10,000 weekly and $40,000 monthly caps are the dealbreaker, and anything above $40,000 is drip-fed in monthly instalments, so a $100,000 win takes three months to fully collect.


Add 3x wagering on every deposit, which on a $50,000 deposit means $150,000 of turnover before you can withdraw a cent, plus no stated payout timeframe, and the picture doesn't improve. For serious money, [BitStarz](placeholder) has no withdrawal caps and commits to a 1-hour target on manual reviews, and [Winz.io](placeholder) allows $100,000 a week and $400,000 a month with a 1-hour payout target too.


DATA FLAG: The database now lists 5,000 games and $10,000 weekly / $40,000 monthly withdrawal limits, while the review published a month ago recorded 7,000+ games and $20,000 / $80,000 limits; both were stated as changes but may be recount or data-entry differences worth re-auditing. Public sources also disagree on the current operator (Dama N.V. versus Scores55 Tech B.V. on the Curaçao register as of mid-2026). The no deposit and SPIN80 bonus rows list a $20 max win alongside $50 and $100 max cashouts, which is internally inconsistent and was left out of the review.
